dedupe_keys.name: finaccess geospatial mapping 2015 locations of 91 158 financial access points and 27 684 agricultural institutions in kenya

description: A national geospatial census of financial access points and agricultural institutions in Kenya, collected between March and August 2015 by Brand Fusion with the Central Bank of Kenya, the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and FSD Kenya. The Dataverse record says it located 91,158 financial access points (including mobile money agents, bank agents, microfinance banks, SACCOs, microfinance institutions and hire purchase companies) and 27,684 agricultural institutions (including agro-dealers, markets, farmer organisations and cooperatives, warehouses and cattle dips). Version 1.2, released on 18 February 2016 and distributed by FSD Kenya, has separate files for agriculture, bank agents, capital markets, commercial banks and mortgage, development finance, forex bureaus, hire purchase, insurance service providers, microfinance banks, microfinance institutions, mobile money agents, money transfer, pensions, post offices, SACCOs and stand-alone ATMs, as Excel or tab-separated tables, the largest about 27 MB; it is free under CC0 1.0. Caveats: it is a 2015 snapshot, and mobile money agent networks change quickly. For simulation it gives the physical footprint of cash-in and cash-out points, to test how power or telecom outages and floods cut access to payments and farm inputs. A related catalogue record is the Global Findex Database.
